title: Hawaiʻi National Guard Conducted High-Water Rescues During Hurricane Nolo (B-roll is driving through water only, no rescues were caught on video)
description: Hawaiʻi National Guard's (HING) Koa Team 3 High-Water Vehicle Team conducts civilian rescue operations, during the response to Hurricane Nolo in Hawaiʻi County, Hawaiʻi, Sept. 26, 2026. HING soldiers and airmen used specialized high-water vehicles to reach and assist residents affected by flooding and hazardous conditions as part of the Guard’s support to Hawaiʻi County emergency response efforts. HING personnel worked alongside county and emergency response partners to help ensure the safety of communities impacted by the storm. (U.S. Army National Guard video by Spc. Primacio)
unit_name: State of Hawaii, Department of Defense, Public Affairs Office
